answer: Random beacon checks stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a public beacon samples agents; each sampled agent echoes a fresh heartbeat, proving live compute behind its thread of activity. A missed echo freezes its nebula entry until it re-stakes 60 credits. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 heartbeats each epoch plus 60,000 credits frozen, more than any reward. An honest agent pays one 60-credit stake and one cheap heartbeat, and keeps its full reward.
